newsitem.title: USA: CHS Electronics completes Merisel deal.
newsitem.headline: CHS Electronics completes Merisel deal.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said on Friday it completed the purchase of nearly all of Merisel Inc's European and Latin American businesses for $154 million.
The transaction involved $36 million in cash, $55 million in factoring proceeds and $63 million in asset securitization borrowings, CHS said.
CHS said the acquisition of the distribution and export businesses would essentially double its revenues.
CHS Electronics is a distributor of microcomputers, peripherals and software products. With the acquisition, it would distribute to about 50,000 resellers in 28 countries in Europe and Latin America.

"It (the purchase) essentially doubles our revenues and transforms us into the second largest distributor in Western Europe," said Claudio Osorio, CHS Electronics' chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Osorio said the acquisition also gave the company a new presence in Mexico.
"We expect to retain key management of Merisel's operating units and foresee substantial cost savings from efficiencies to be realized from the combined operations," Osorio said.
He said the company also expected cost savings in Europe after operations were consolidated.
